tasks.label: lanzarBrowserSync
args:
command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo 'Se requiere curl para verificar BrowserSync.' >&2; exit 1; }
url=$1
shift
echo 'Iniciando BrowserSync'
browser-sync "$@" &
server=$!
trap 'kill "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
deadline=$((SECONDS + 15))
until curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --max-time 1 --output /dev/null "$url"; do
    if ! kill -0 "$server" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "$server"
        exit 1
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= deadline )); then
        echo "BrowserSync no respondió en $url" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 0.1
done
echo 'BrowserSync listo'
wait "$server"
